def transform(g):

    # frames: draw full border for even k, then remove ray cells (up-left ray from (si-1,sj)), add odd-ring ray cells
    ray=lambda t:(si-1-t, sj-t)
    rayset={ray(t) for t in range(0, max(h,w)+2)}
    for k in range(2, max(h,w)+2, 2):
        cells=[]
        for j in range(sj-k+1, sj+k):  # top and bottom rows (excluding corners to avoid dup, add corners too)

        for i in range(si-k, si+k+1):

        # drawing path from gap clockwise: start after gap on top row going right
        # order: top row from (si-k, sj-k+1) to (si-k, sj+k); right col down; bottom row right->left; left col up to (si-k, sj-k)
        path=[]
        path += [(si-k, j) for j in range(sj-k+1, sj+k+1)]
        path += [(i, sj+k) for i in range(si-k+1, si+k+1)]
        path += [(si+k, j) for j in range(sj+k-1, sj-k-1, -1)]

        if drawn:
            for c in path:
                if c in rayset: continue
                i,j=c
                if 0<=i<h and 0<=j<w: out[i][j]=3
        else:
            for c in path[:stop]:
                if c in rayset: continue
                i,j=c
                if 0<=i<h and 0<=j<w: out[i][j]=3
    # ray cells: t even (odd rings) up to kmax-1; t odd -> ensure 0 (frame removal) unless 2
    for t in range(0, max(h,w)+2):

def transform(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    si,sj=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==3][0]
    twos={(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==2}
    # build one global path: seed, then for k=2,4,6,...: ray cell ring k-1 (t=k-2), then frame k path from its gap
    path=[(si,sj)]
    def ray(t): return (si-1-t, sj-t)
    for k in range(2, max(h,w)*3, 2):
        t=k-2
        i,j=ray(t)
        if 0<=i<h and 0<=j<w: path.append((i,j))
        # frame k path clockwise starting after gap (gap = ray cell ring k, t=k-1)
        gp=ray(k-1)
        top=si-k; bot=si+k; left=sj-k; right=sj+k
        seg=[]
        seg += [(top,j) for j in range(left+1, right+1)]
        seg += [(i,right) for i in range(top+1, bot+1)]
        seg += [(bot,j) for j in range(right-1, left-1, -1)]
        seg += [(i,left) for i in range(bot-1, top-1, -1)]
        if gp in seg:
            idx=seg.index(gp)
            seg=seg[idx+1:]+seg[:idx+1]  # start after gap, end at gap
        path+=seg
        # stop extending if frame entirely off grid
        if bot<0 or top>=h or right<0 or left>=w: break
    stopped=False
    for i,j in path:
        if stopped: 
            if (i,j) not in twos and 0<=i<h and 0<=j<w: out[i][j]=0
            continue
        if (i,j) in twos:
            stopped=True; continue
        if 0<=i<h and 0<=j<w: out[i][j]=3
    return out
